title: Degree Power Sums in Extremal Set Systems
summary: For a family $\mathcal F\subseteq\binom{[n]}k$ and $R\in\binom{[n]}r$, let $d_{\mathcal F}(R)=|\{F\in\mathcal F:R\subseteq F\}|$ and $\ell_{r,p}(\mathcal F)=\sum_{R\in\binom{[n]}r}d_{\mathcal F}(R)^p$; write $co_p(\mathcal F)=\ell_{k-1,p}(\mathcal F)$ for the codegree power sum. We introduce a method that uses convexity to extend sharp bounds for degree sums and sums of squared degrees to real powers, while retaining all equality cases.
